description: Follow crypto whales from a workflow. CoinLobster records the large trades executed on the big exchanges, on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum DEXes and on Hyperliquid, and judges each coin's whale flow against its own normal. List whale trades by coin, exchange and side, see which coins have unusual whale flow right now, check one coin's activity against its history, follow a Hyperliquid wallet, and get liquidations, signals with their track record and a market overview.
